_comment: ngsolve thermal_structural#1 (GridFunction.Set() is a whole-vector overwrite, not an accumulate-into-a-region). Verified 2026-08-03 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.3, H1(order=2, dirichlet='left|right'). After the first Set the vector spans [-2.92e-13, 100.0]; after the second it is exactly [0.0, 0.0]. Swapping the call order leaves [-2.92e-13, 100.0], so only the LAST call ever survives. The single-call fix gfT.Set(IfPos(0.5-x, 100, 0), definedon=mesh.Boundaries('left|right')) restores [-2.92e-13, 100.0]. Carried through the shipped thermal_structural_2d recipe the two-call idiom yields T_max=0 and tip u_x=0.0 at rc=0 -- the 'Temperature: [0.00, 0.00]' the template prints -- while the one-call version gives T_max=100 and a nonzero tip displacement.
